login.title: Sign in to FairShift
login.heading: Fair hours, transparent pay and safer work.
login.point1: Check in and out, and see every hour and rupee of your pay explained.
login.point2: Report hazards, confidentially if you choose, and follow the fix.
login.point3: Give honest feedback without your name.
login.point4: English and ಕನ್ನಡ, with voice help on phones that support it.
login.sdg: Built for UN Sustainable Development Goal 8 — decent work and economic growth.
login.demoHint: These accounts exist only for demonstration. Choose one to fill the form.
login.googleNotConfigured: Google Sign-In is not configured in this environment (set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET).
login.githubNotConfigured: GitHub OAuth is not configured in this environment.
login.otp.sent: Verification code sent to {phone}. Valid for 5 minutes.
login.otp.notConfigured: SMS OTP is not configured in this environment (set SMS_PROVIDER=twilio or mock in development).
login.error.unprovisioned: Account not provisioned: No FairShift organization account is linked to your Google identity ({email}). Please contact your organization administrator to create your profile.
login.error.sessionExpired: Sign-in session expired or was interrupted. Please try again.
login.error.stateMismatch: Security verification failed (state mismatch). Please try again.

pay.explainHours: You worked {regular} of regular time and {overtime} of overtime from {from} to {to}.
pay.explainRule: Overtime is time worked beyond {scheduled} on any one day.
pay.capped: Reduced so that take-home pay does not go below zero.
pay.openExcluded: {count} shift(s) still open are not included yet.
pay.syntheticNote: Sample calculation from synthetic demo data. This is not an official payroll document.
pay.realNote: FairShift calculates this from recorded shifts. It is not connected to a payroll system; ask your employer if the numbers differ.
pay.none: No payslips have been issued yet.
rep.title: Safety reports
rep.none: You have not reported any hazards.
rep.descriptionHint: What is unsafe, and who could get hurt?
rep.confidentialHint: Your name is not stored with a confidential report and is not shown to your employer. Only you can see it is yours. Details you write (like your exact location or crew) could still identify you.
rep.submitted: Report sent. You can follow its status here.
rep.reportedHazardNote: This is a reported hazard. It becomes "resolved" only when your employer records that it has been fixed.
sev.critical: Critical – danger to life, act now
fb.title: Feedback
fb.intro: Tell your employer about working conditions. Give a rating, a comment, or both.
fb.privacy1: Your name and account are not saved with your feedback. Only the date is stored, not the time.
fb.privacy2: Your employer sees average ratings only when at least 3 people answered a topic.
fb.privacy3: This is not perfect anonymity: if you mention details only you would know, you could be recognised. Server logs may briefly record that your device used the app.
fb.thanks: Thank you. Your feedback was sent without your name.

sk.intro: A record of your skills, training and certificates that you can show to future employers.
sk.name: Name
sk.verifyNote: "Checked by employer" means your employer confirmed this entry. FairShift does not verify certificates with outside bodies.
err.notAllowed: You do not have access to this page.

dispute.title: Worker Wage Discrepancy Notice Generator
dispute.draftNotice: This tool generates a factual summary notice of your recorded hours, earnings, and unpaid discrepancies based on cryptographic FairShift receipts.
dispute.statementHint: Describe the specific discrepancy factually. You can edit this before generating the notice.
dispute.disclaimerShort: This notice is a worker-prepared statement of recorded facts. It is not formal legal counsel or a certified statutory filing.

heat.seekHelp: Stop work immediately and seek medical attention if dizzy, nauseated, or stopped sweating.

lang.partialNote: Messages from your employer, and some technical details, may stay in English.
home.nothingNeeded: Nothing needs your attention right now.
week.label: Hours by day
jar.heading: Your money jar
jar.agreedExplain: {days} days × {hours} a day at {rate} an hour, as set by your employer
jar.agreedUnavailable: No hourly rate or scheduled day is set for this period, so there is nothing to compare.
jar.lessThanAgreed: {amount} less than agreed: fewer hours were recorded than scheduled
jar.issuedExplain: Issued by your employer for this period.
jar.estimateExplain: An estimate from your recorded shifts. It can change until your employer issues the payslip.
jar.agreedDefinition: What your hourly rate and scheduled hours add up to for the days you worked. It is a comparison, not a contract.
jar.workedDefinition: Pay for the hours FairShift recorded, at your rate, before anything is taken out. Also called gross pay.
jar.overtimeDefinition: Time beyond {hours} in one day. It is paid at {multiplier} your hourly rate.
jar.deductionsDefinition: Amounts your employer takes out of gross pay, such as provident fund or an advance. Each one is listed on the payslip.
jar.netDefinition: Gross pay minus deductions. This is the amount you should receive.
jar.paidDefinition: FairShift does not see bank or cash payments. If the amount you receive is different, raise it with your employer.
pay.weekCalculation: How this week's pay is calculated
proof.sealAnchoredDetail: It is also part of checkpoint {sequence}, sealed on {date}.
proof.sealUnanchoredDetail: It will be added to the next checkpoint.
proof.sealBroken: This record does not match its seal
proof.sealBrokenDetail: Something in this record is different from what was sealed when it was issued. Ask your employer to explain the difference.
proof.sealPartial: Its checkpoint could not be confirmed
proof.sealPartialDetail: The shift record matches its seal, but the checkpoint it belongs to could not be confirmed. Ask your employer to look into it.
proof.sealUnavailable: The seal could not be checked right now
proof.sealLimits: Checked by FairShift's server using your organisation's key. The seal shows this record has not changed since it was issued. It does not prove that the times recorded were correct.
proof.downloadHint: The file holds this receipt and its place in the checkpoint. Someone with your organisation's checkpoint key can confirm it; without the key, it only shows that the parts fit together.
proof.downloadFailed: The proof file could not be downloaded. Try again.
receipt.none: There is no receipt for this shift yet.
receipt.estimateNote: Before deductions. An estimate until the payslip for this period is issued.
receipt.finalNote: Before deductions. The payslip for this period has been issued.
receipt.viewingOld: You are looking at version {version}, which has since been changed.
